method: DKI records come from BP BUMD Jakarta's public profile, ownership and structured financial endpoints.
Financial values are full rupiah as returned by the structured endpoint; no scaling or GVA conversion is applied.
An ownership edge is created only from a named shareholder record. Location alone never creates an ownership edge.
Company-published contacts are retained; an address matching an active officer's personal mailbox pattern is suppressed.
